summary: Backend-only test of the 3 new Bulk IVR features (Pause/Resume/Cancel, international pricing, voicemail drop) on Telnyx. I wrote a new sandbox edge harness, js/tests/test_bulk_controls_edge_2026-10.js, with 32 checks. It uses the real bulk-call-service + voice-service and stubs Telnyx/Twilio/Telegram; sandbox Mongo is on :27999, so no real calls. It found 3 real bugs. I fixed 2 of them with small edits: (1) a campaign whose LAST lead's billing drained the wallet was left 'paused' forever, with no final report and a 'top up then Resume' message for a finished campaign. The same root cause left a user-paused campaign stuck at 100% once its last in-flight call settled. (2) In voicemail drop, a call.machine.greeting.ended arriving while gather_stop was still in flight overwrote the 120 s max-play timer, so that timer was never cleared. One small issue is reported, not fixed: the pre-launch estimate counts blocked destinations (e.g. Cuba +53) at $10/min even though they are never dialled or billed. After the fixes: new edge harness 31/32 (the remaining fail is the estimate issue), test_bulk_telnyx_2026-10 48/48, test_bulk_telnyx_edge_2026-10 17/17, test_bulkivr_wallet 10/10, test_twilio_switch_2026-10 43/43, test_bulk_provider_suspended_2026-10 7/8 (REQ-69 is the known baseline failure). nodejs restarted; /api/health 200. The Telegram UI in _index.js was only code-reviewed; I did not drive it through the mock Telegram.

critical.endpoint: bulk-call-service billLead post-billing check / pauseForWallet / checkCampaignCompletion
critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent. If the last lead's billing dropped the wallet below $0.15, pauseForWallet flipped running→paused before checkCampaignCompletion ran. checkCampaignCompletion only accepted 'running', so the campaign never completed and no final report or CSV was sent. The user got 'Wallet Depleted — top up, then tap Resume' for a finished campaign. Same root cause: pausing with only the last call(s) in flight left the campaign 'paused' at 100%. Edge harness E03 failed against the original code (status=paused, reportDocs=0) and E14 likewise; both pass after the fix.

minor.issue: FIXED. startVoicemailWait armed the beep-wait timer AFTER awaiting gather_stop. If greeting.ended arrived meanwhile, playVoicemailDrop set the 120 s max-play timer, and startVoicemailWait then overwrote session._vmTimer with the beep timer. Hangup only cleared the beep timer, so the 120 s timer was orphaned and would later send hangup to a dead call. Found by reading the code; I could not run the old code inside the harness to confirm it. Also: no max-play timer is armed if the call ended while playback_start was in flight. Edge harness E17/E21 pass.

HARDENED, not proven to be a bug. The completed flip was not atomic, so two last calls settling at the same moment could in theory each send the final report. It is now an atomic status-filtered update, and the report is sent only when this update changes the campaign. E20 (parallel final settlements → 1 report) passes.

NOT FIXED. Blocked destinations (satellite/premium, e.g. Cuba +5352345678) count at the $10/min recovery rate in the preview and the start estimate (2 leads US+Cuba → $10.15, 'Rate: … $10.00/min international'). The dial guard refuses these numbers at dial time (lead failed, $0), so the estimate is inflated and alarming. Suggest skipping dialGuard.classifyDial(n).blocked leads in the estimate and showing 'N blocked numbers will be skipped'. Note: the review request's example 'Cuba +53 → higher rate' is in fact a BLOCKED destination, not a high-cost one. High-cost billing was verified with Comoros +269 3212345 ($1.43/min, 61 s → $2.86; the rate is recorded in phoneLogs and the ledger description). Harness check E06d.

critical_code_review_comments: Reviewed and found correct: claimLead filters on status:'running', so pause or cancel racing an in-progress fireNextBatch can never dial a lead (verified E07/E08/E09)

Reviewed and found correct: parallel resume is atomic via status:'paused' claim (E07); resume after a restart hangs up orphaned legs and keeps warm ones (E11/E12); late completion of an old leg is ignored thanks to the $or callSid guard (E11b)
Reviewed and found correct: callback ownership check String(campaign.chatId) === chatId, where chatId is String(query.message.chat.id), so other users get 'Campaign not found.'

Reviewed and found correct: bulkSelectVoicemail / Back navigation / Twilio skip / Launch + Schedule both pass voicemailAudioUrl + voicemailAudioName to createCampaign; My Campaigns is wired in submenu5 + bulkRunning; btn.myCampaigns is localized en/fr/zh/hi

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: node js/tests/test_bulk_controls_edge_2026-10.js (needs mongod on :27999; start with mongod --port 27999 --dbpath /tmp/m27999 --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --fork --logpath /tmp/m27999.log). Starting a campaign needs a $20 minimum wallet, so the harness starts users at $25 and lowers usdOut after the first dial. E06d stays FAIL until the estimate for blocked destinations is changed. REQ-69 in test_bulk_provider_suspended is a known baseline failure. Telegram callback/UI flows were not driven end-to-end — a mock-Telegram run of bulk_view/pause/resume/cancel/cancelyes and the bulkSelectVoicemail step is still open.
rca of the issue: Last-lead pause bug: finalizeLead → billLead → post-billing smartWalletCheck(0.15) fails → pauseForWallet (status running→paused) → fireNextBatch returns (paused) → checkCampaignCompletion returned early because status !== 'running'. Repro: 1-lead campaign, wallet $0.20 after the dial, 30 s answered call → $0.05 left → campaign stays paused with 1/1 done and no report. Mitigation: pauseForWallet now requires 'leads.status':'pending' in its atomic filter, and checkCampaignCompletion completes running OR paused campaigns once every lead is final.
